{npc:Amanda}, priestess of the Edron temple, needs holy water from the {wiki:White Raven Monastery} to purify the unholy cemetery north of the city. Fetch the water from {npc:Costello} on the Isle of the Kings, pour it on the 15 graves in the cemetery and receive a package with 5 Health Potions and 5 Mana Potions.
Have completed {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest} (access to the Isle of the Kings).
36.00 oz, contains 5 Health Potions and 5 Mana Potions

Bring money for the trips: Edron → Carlin (110 gp with {npc:Captain Seahorse}), Carlin → Isle of the Kings (10 gp with {npc:Dalbrect}), the return with {npc:Captain Jack} and Carlin → Edron (110 gp with {npc:Captain Greyhound}).
Go to the temple in **Edron** and talk to {npc:Amanda}: say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. She asks you for a flask of holy water from the White Raven Monastery.
The Isle of the Kings is west of **Carlin**. At the Edron port talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} (110 gp).
Get to the Isle of the Kings

In Carlin, go to the hut and boat of {npc:Dalbrect}, at the port in the **north and west** of the city (north of the {wiki:Ghostlands|Ghostlands}). Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}: he takes you to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings|Isle of the Kings} for 10 gp. He only accepts if you have already done the {wiki:Family Brooch Quest|Family Brooch Quest} (part of the White Raven Monastery Quest).
Dalbrect (boat to the Isle of the Kings)

At the arrival point on the Isle of the Kings, enter the monks' building (White Raven Monastery) and talk to {npc:Costello}: say {key:hi}, {key:holy water} and {key:Amanda}. You receive the {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)}.
Leave the Isle of the Kings
To return to the mainland, go to the boat moored on the island and talk to {npc:Captain Jack}, Dalbrect's friend: say {key:hi} and {key:tibia}. He takes you back to the mainland, to the Carlin side.
Do not enter the 3rd floor of the monastery (restricted monks' area): if you do, Captain Jack won't take you back until you pay the fine to Costello ({key:absolution}).
Captain Jack only takes you if you have {npc:Costello}'s permission to leave the island.
In Carlin, go to the port and talk to {npc:Captain Greyhound}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (110 gp). You arrive at the Edron port; the temple of {npc:Amanda} is in the city.
Go back to Edron and tell {npc:Amanda} {key:hi} and {key:mission}. She sends you to pour the water on every grave in the unholy cemetery north of Edron.
Leave Edron to the **north** to the {wiki:Ghoul Hill|Unholy Cemetery}, north of the city (it's on the surface, you don't need a rope or a shovel).
On the way there are {creature:Poacher|Poachers} and {creature:Hunter|Hunters}; in the cemetery there are {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}.
Using the water on the 15 graves
Use the {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)} on **each of the 15 graves**. After the last one, the flask is empty.

From the cemetery, walk **south** back to the temple in **Edron** and tell {npc:Amanda} {key:hi} and {key:mission}. She gives you a {item:Package of Potions} with 5 {item:Health Potion|Health Potions} and 5 {item:Mana Potion|Mana Potions}.
The quest shows up in the Quest Log under *Tibia Tales*.
